scope: All 39 remaining whole-token razsmotr- forms in base-papers1-43-isv.tex: four consider imperatives, four perfective consider infinitives, 20 consideration nouns, and 11 passive or case-inflected derivatives.
choice: Remove the official type-3 Russian/SH-shaped razsmotr- family and move its complete inflectional surface into the already-established razgled- family. Authorial 'let us consider' forms become razgledajmo; perfective infinitives become razgleděti.
motivation: EDIT-0030 and EDIT-0041 normalized the parallel razsmatr-/razmatr-/smatr- families but missed the third razsmotr- stem. The official dictionary marks råzsmotriti as type 3 and offers official råzględati/rázględěti for consider/examine. Leaving 39 tokens would preserve exactly the internal lexical fragmentation those two earlier edits removed.

construction_correction_required.finding: A post-application German phrase check distinguished five source Überlegung sites from ordinary Betrachtung and found two idioms corresponding to in Betracht kommen. The mechanical successor is therefore preserved as an intermediate head, not misreported as the final semantic wording.
construction_correction_required.next_action: EDIT-0050 replaces five reasoning nouns with razvažanje inflections and recasts the two idioms to v razgled.

alternatives_rejected: Retain official type-3 råzsmotriti: it is explicitly RU/SH-derived and inconsistent with the accepted family policy.
Map every noun to razvažanje: most aligned German sites say Betrachtung/Betrachtungen and denote examination or treatment, not inferential deliberation.
Map the two in-Betracht idioms to v razgledanje: that literal noun government is unnatural and is corrected immediately in EDIT-0050.
Hide or roll back the first applied successor after finding the semantic distinction: the intermediate hash is retained and superseded append-only.
